paper: Wang, Zhao, Yatskar, Chang, Ordonez. Balanced Datasets Are Not Enough: Estimating and Mitigating Gender Bias in Deep Image Representations
date_version: ICCV 2019 (main conf.); arXiv 1811.08489 (earlier title 'Adversarial Removal of Gender from Deep Image Representations')
question_scope: Defines dataset leakage (attacker predicting gender from ground-truth task labels, recalibrated to the model's F1 by random label flipping) vs model leakage (attacker on the model's task outputs); bias amplification = difference at matched accuracy; evaluates adversarial removal at image/conv4/conv5.
method_coverage: Original CNN/CRF models; adversarial removal (3 placements); baselines: Gaussian-noise randomization, rebalanced splits, blur/blackout of faces/segments/boxes; RBA. COCO multilabel, imSitu.
task_utility_protocol: Task mAP/F1 per method on same test split; leakage compared at matched F1 (lambda_D(F1)); trade-off plot leakage vs F1.
attacker_access: Black-box task outputs (pre-activation logits) or ground-truth labels; attacker = 4-layer MLP trained on held-out outputs.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Nonlinear MLP attacker; ablation over attacker depth/training size (Table 2: <2 pt variation except 1-layer). Not defense-aware.
task_output_eval: YES - central measurement: attribute recovery from task outputs, with a label-only reference recovery at matched accuracy.
statistical_treatment: Point estimates; attacker-robustness ablation; no CIs or seeds reported in sections read.
overlap_durable_guarantees: STRONG: label-only baseline vs output recovery (dataset vs model leakage) is a direct precedent for 'output-side leakage predicted by AUC(s|y)'. Not found by string search in AAAI-27 bib or durable-guarantees@956f5c8.
possible_additional_value: DG differs: certified/erasure methods, AUC metric, defense-aware tier, tabular data, prediction of output leakage from AUC(s|y) rather than measuring both. Must be cited and positioned against.
full_text_reading_status: Sections 3-5 and Tables 1-5 read (pdftotext of arXiv v2/ICCV text).
supporting_locations: Sec.3 'Leakage and Amplification' (definitions lambda_D, lambda_M, Delta); Sec.4 'Attacker Learning is Robust' Table 2; Sec.5 Tables 3-5, Fig.5

paper: Hirota, Nakashima, Garcia. Quantifying Societal Bias Amplification in Image Captioning (LIC)
question_scope: Leakage-for-image-captioning metric: attacker recovers gender/skin tone from generated captions (gender words masked) vs from human captions; LIC = LIC_M - LIC_D.
method_coverage: 9 captioning models (NIC, SAT, FC, Att2in, UpDn, Transformer, OSCAR, NIC+, NIC+Equalizer); MSCOCO subset.
task_utility_protocol: Standard caption metrics (BLEU-4, CIDEr, METEOR, ROUGE-L) per model; bias metrics alongside.
attacker_access: Black-box generated text (task outputs); attacker = LSTM or BERT text classifier trained on balanced split.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Neural text attackers; not defense-aware.
task_output_eval: YES - recovery from generated outputs relative to human-label baseline.
statistical_treatment: Point estimates in tables read; multiple attacker encoders (LSTM/BERT).
overlap_durable_guarantees: Moderate: same 'output leakage minus label leakage' structure as LB01 in a generative setting.
possible_additional_value: Generative-output analogue; no certified removal, no utility-matched comparison of removal methods.
full_text_reading_status: Sec.3 metric definitions and Sec.5 experimental setup/Table 1 read; remaining results skimmed.
supporting_locations: Sec.3 Eq.(leakage), LIC Eqs; Sec.5 'Data','Metrics','Models'; Tables 1-2

paper: Ravfogel, Goldberg, Cotterell. Log-linear Guardedness and its Implications
date_version: ACL 2023 (main conf.); arXiv 2210.10012 (v1 title 'Linear Guardedness and its Implications')
question_scope: Theory+experiment: after (approximate) log-linear guarding with RLACE, can a downstream log-linear task classifier's outputs leak the erased attribute? Binary task: bounded; multiclass task: an adversarially chosen softmax classifier recovers it.
method_coverage: RLACE on BERT [CLS] (PCA-256), Bias-in-Bios; 15 binary profession pairs; multiclass |Y|=2..64.
task_utility_protocol: Not a utility comparison; guardedness validated by linear probes (<=2% above majority).
attacker_access: Representation guarded; attacker sees task predictions (argmax) from (a) an independently trained profession classifier, (b) an adversarially co-trained composition of two log-linear models.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Adversarially constructed downstream classifier (defense-aware in the sense of being optimized against the guarded representation); delta-discretization post hoc.
task_output_eval: YES - V-information leaked by downstream predictions Y_p and adversarial Y_a.
statistical_treatment: Mean +/- 1 sd over 15 profession pairs; held-out estimation.
overlap_durable_guarantees: STRONG for output side: shows task outputs from a linearly guarded representation can leak (practically small for honestly trained binary task, large for adversarial multiclass). Not found in AAAI-27 bib by string search.
overlap_pcrl: Relevant to dominant-axis multiclass audit: multiclass heads can re-expose a linearly guarded attribute.
possible_additional_value: Does not measure realistic multiclass task heads trained for utility, nor AUC(s|y) prediction, nor tabular/certified LEACE.
full_text_reading_status: Sec.5 and App.A.3 read fully.

paper: Aalmoes, Duddu, Boutet. On the Alignment of Group Fairness with Attribute Privacy
date_version: arXiv 2211.10209 v1 2022-11-18 titled 'Leveraging Algorithmic Fairness to Mitigate Blackbox Attribute Inference Attacks'; v3 2024-03-05. Semantic Scholar lists WISE (pp.333-348); publisher page not opened.
question_scope: Output-based attribute inference (AdaptAIA, adaptive threshold for class imbalance) against fair classifiers; shows DP/EO-type group fairness bounds AIA on hard/soft labels.
method_coverage: Exponentiated gradient (EGD) and adversarial debiasing on CENSUS, COMPAS, MEPS, LFW.
task_utility_protocol: Target-model utility reported per fairness strength; no cross-method utility matching.
attacker_access: Black-box hard labels (TM1) or soft labels (TM2); auxiliary data from test distribution; attack model on outputs.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Adaptive threshold (imbalance-aware), not defense-aware beyond that.
task_output_eval: YES - attribute recovery from task outputs of fair models; theoretical vs empirical bounds.
overlap_durable_guarantees: Moderate: output-side recovery with fairness constraints as a defense; DG's 'outputs leak what they use' relates (output leakage tied to fairness criterion).
possible_additional_value: Fairness-constrained classifiers, not representation erasure; no label-only baseline.
full_text_reading_status: Problem statement, setup and Sec.5 results read; Secs.6-7 skimmed.
supporting_locations: Sec.3 TM1/TM2; Sec.4 setup; Sec.5 Table 2

paper: Ferry, Aivodji, Gambs, Huguet, Siala. Exploiting Fairness to Enhance Sensitive Attributes Reconstruction
date_version: IEEE SaTML 2023 (pp.18-41 per Semantic Scholar); arXiv 2209.01215 v1
question_scope: Defense-aware dataset-level attack: adversary corrects an initial sensitive-attribute reconstruction using the published fairness constraint (constraint programming).
method_coverage: Fairlearn ExponentiatedGradient and ThresholdOptimizer (decision-tree base), 4 fairness metrics, many tolerances; Adult, ACSPublicCoverage-TX, ACSIncome-TX.
task_utility_protocol: Target models' train/test performance reported (App.B); not a cross-method utility comparison.
attacker_access: Adversary A knows (X,Y) of training set + auxiliary attack set; A0 additionally gets model predictions; both plus fairness info.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Defense-aware: exploits the fairness guarantee itself as side information.
task_output_eval: Partly: A0 uses task predictions; A vs A0 is a labels-only vs labels+outputs comparison.
multiple_release_eval: No (single model; fairness statement acts as an extra released quantity).
statistical_treatment: 100 repetitions with different split seeds; mean +/- sd.
overlap_durable_guarantees: STRONG for the two-tier/defense-aware idea and for the labels-only vs outputs comparison (adversary A vs A0) at dataset level.
overlap_pcrl: Weak: the released fairness statistic is an additional 'permitted release' combined with predictions - a composition example.
possible_additional_value: Training-set reconstruction (not per-recipient inference on fresh individuals); no representations.
full_text_reading_status: Sec.IV setup and C results read (Adult); appendices not read.
supporting_locations: Sec.III-A pipeline; Sec.IV-A baseline adversaries A/A0; Sec.IV-B setup (100 runs); Fig.2

paper: Tian, Zhang, Liu, Zhu, Ding, Zhou. Do Fairness Interventions Come at the Cost of Privacy: Evaluations for Binary Classifiers
date_version: arXiv 2503.06150 v2 2025-03-11; arXiv page states accepted to IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (journal version not opened)
question_scope: MIA/AIA against fair-mixup models; finds fairness interventions reduce standard attack success but a 'fairness discrepancy' attack combining a biased model's and a fair model's predictions (FD-AIA) improves attribute inference.
method_coverage: Fair mixup variants; CelebA (smile/gender), UTKFace and FairFace (race/gender); 6-layer CNN targets.
task_utility_protocol: Target accuracy/fairness reported; no cross-method utility matching.
attacker_access: Black-box predictions from BOTH a biased and a fair model (A(x)=f(T_b(x),T_f(x))); white-box embedding variant.
nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: Not defense-aware per se, but exploits the existence of two model versions.
task_output_eval: YES - attribute inference from task outputs.
multiple_release_eval: YES (closest found): combining two releases (pre/post-debiasing versions of the same task model) increases attribute inference.
statistical_treatment: Distributions over 100 runs for prediction gaps; tables of attack accuracy; CIs not seen in sections read.
overlap_durable_guarantees: Moderate: output-side AIA on fair models.
overlap_pcrl: STRONG analogue of coalition/concatenation recovery: two individually-less-leaky releases combined leak more. Differs: same task, model versions, images.
possible_additional_value: Our coalition setting (different purposes, different recipients, certified per-release protection, tabular, utility-matched) not covered.
full_text_reading_status: Secs.6-7.1 read; results tables partially.

nonlinear_or_adaptive_eval: White-box neuron attack (stronger); not defense-aware.

overlap_durable_guarantees: Methodological precedent for reporting gain over a no-release baseline (DG has docs/imputation_baseline.md and cites this paper in AAAI bib).
